source_url.description: pharmgkb_drug_adapter.py's own --label variants path builds this as .../variant/<rsid> from the raw source TSV. The S3-backup remediation script (find_and_create_missing_variants.py) doesn't have the rsid available (not carried onto the variants_drugs edge), so it falls back to the edge's own .../variantAnnotation/<id> URL instead - still a real, traceable pharmgkb.org page, just not the variant-specific one. Pattern is intentionally broadened to the whole domain to accept both forms.
